description: Benzi is a compiler-backed coding agent that transforms your codebase into a resolved map of calls, data flow, references and class hierarchy, then reads, explains, runs, edits and verifies your code through it. Includes a runtime tracer that settles what static analysis can't.
summary: Benzi is code intelligence infrastructure for AI models.  Claude Code greps; Cursor embeds; Aider maps signatures; Benzi resolves — and answers in O(1). Every language runs its own tree-sitter grammar into the same query map.
